Definition: Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jezreel = "God sows"; n pr m; 1) a descendant of the father or founder of Etam of Judah; 2) first son of Hosea the prophet; n pr loc; 3) a city in the Nekeb of Judah; 4) a city in Issachar on the northwest spur of Mount Gilboa
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
